title: The Topology of Multimodal Fusion: Why Current Architectures Fail at Creative Cognition
reasoning: The paper utilizes Chinese epistemology and spiritual traditions (such as the Yijing and Taoist concepts of dào and qì) as a foundational theoretical pillar. It further proposes the META-TOP benchmark, which includes a 'cross-civilizational' tier (L3) that uses archetypes and texts from these traditions to evaluate the topological reasoning capabilities of AI models.
